visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short, styled brown hair and glasses, wearing a white short-sleeved button-down shirt with black graphic prints, sits indoors on a light-colored sofa. He holds a large, round, metallic golden box featuring a Bitcoin logo cutout. The background shows a neutral-toned living room with minimalist decorations and a blue cushion. (2) He rotates the golden box to demonstrate its size and reflective finish. The box has a leather-like strap. Large yellow text subtitles appear at the bottom of the frame. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the textures of his shirt and the shiny surface of the gift box. (3) He removes the golden lid, revealing several gold-wrapped individual mooncake packages nestled inside. He selects one rectangular package and holds it up to the camera. His hands move with precision as he begins to tear the gold foil wrapper, showing the packaging details clearly under the studio-style lights. (4) A close-up shot focuses on his hands holding a circular, golden-brown mooncake embossed with the Bitcoin logo. He brings it to his mouth and takes a large bite. The camera then shows a cross-section of the mooncake, revealing a yellow, fibrous filling that looks like pineapple or egg yolk. (5) The scene cuts to a woman with long, straight brown hair in a light blue top sitting at a light wooden table. She holds a green seaweed-wrapped snack roll. She smiles at the camera, showing her facial expressions as she eats. A smartphone and other snacks are visible on the table background. (6) The man returns to the frame, sitting behind the open golden box. He looks at the camera with a satisfied expression and gives two thumbs up. The overall setting remains the bright, comfortable living room. Captions continue to pulse at the bottom of the screen to emphasize his closing remarks.
